description:
v3 is not done until it reproduces v2/TUAS behaviour on the SAME tests. This is the bead that decides whether the OPCPFluidArray migration was faithful.

TARGET SUITE - crates/tuas_boussinesq_solver/.../ciet_educational_simulator_loop_prototypes/regression_tests.rs:
  ciet_coupled_nat_circ_set_a1_for_three_branch
  zero_flow_for_three_branch_ver_1
  flow_diode_reverse_flow_for_three_branch_ver1
  flow_diode_fwd_flow_for_three_branch_ver1
plus the coupled-DRACS natural-circulation and parasitic-heat-loss suites under pre_built_components/ciet_steady_state_natural_circulation_test_components/.

TOLERANCES ARE NOT TO BE LOOSENED. The existing suite carries its own (e.g. pri-loop relative tolerance 0.061, DRACS 0.062). If v3 misses, that is a finding to report, not a tolerance to widen - the workspace rule is explicit that a long or inconvenient test is never a reason to relax a bound.

RUNTIME WARNING from the workspace CLAUDE.md: these CIET natural-circulation tests integrate a coupled loop at 0.1 s timestep for 2000-2500 s of simulated time. They are VERY long running, MUST be run in parallel (never --test-threads=1), and a default 120 s command timeout will kill them mid-run. A timeout is not a failure.
title: CIET v3 ACCEPTANCE GATE: re-validate against the SAME TUAS CIET regression tests

description:
Parent: op-841p. MAINTAINER DECISION 2026-08-11: use the GeN-Foam port, NOT crates/bedok. bedok stays as a noted alternative at a different fidelity band (3-D nodal diffusion + channel TH), not this rung.

GeN-Foam is an AI-assisted draft with NO human V&V - nothing in it may be described as validated. Its implementation state (verified 2026-08-11) is nonetheless substantial: diffusion (crates/outram-foam-appbuilder-lib/src/genfoam/neutronics/diffusion/, solve_eigenvalue at eigenvalue.rs:63), SP3 (sp3/mod.rs:162), SN (sn/mod.rs:197), point kinetics (point_kinetics/mod.rs:433) and multi_region coupling (3953 lines, 24 tests) are all implemented with zero todo!().

THE ACTUAL BLOCKER IS THE DRIVER, NOT THE PHYSICS. crates/outram-foam-cli/src/bin/gen_foam.rs:34-41 returns an error; its two stated prerequisites at :18-21 are a case-constructible top-level solver and a constant/nuclearData reader. That is bead op-p6p.16 and it is the single thing between the implemented physics and a runnable deterministic rung. (gen_foam.rs:7-10's doc comment is stale - it claims only point kinetics is translated, which the module inventory contradicts. Worth fixing in passing.)

DELIVERABLE: k_eff on the same problem as rung 1, with the discrepancy quoted IN PCM and carrying the rung-1 statistical uncertainty. Also record the mesh used and its quality metrics - see the meshing bead; results computed before op-79c is resolved carry an unquantified mesh-quality error and must say so.
title: HTR-10 rung 3: GeN-Foam deterministic multiphysics on the tet-dual mesh

description:
gh:#187 https://github.com/theodoreOnzGit/outram-park-backend/issues/187
Index gh:#186, epic op-qhm1. Found in commit d4b0da78f.

Specular reflection off a sphere concentric with a lump conserves b = r
sin(theta), so a neutron with b > R_lump can NEVER enter the lump. Measured: a
lump 0.034 mfp across -- transparent, so the cell provably IS the homogeneous
mixture -- came out +39 % on the resonance escape probability, and the same
39-43 % at 0.10, 0.34, 0.86 and 2.57 mfp. A bias flat across two decades of
optical thickness cannot be self-shielding; that flatness is the fingerprint.
White closure (random re-entry point, cosine inward) removes it entirely.

Same failure mode as the resonance-adaptive grid trap: a wrong answer plausible
in exactly the direction one is already suspicious of. What caught it was a LIMIT
WHERE THE ANSWER IS INDEPENDENTLY KNOWN, not judgement. Standing rule: build every
oracle so it can be run in a regime whose answer you already have, and run it
there FIRST.

Guarded by tests/ring_rpt_hunt_lessons.rs::
a_transparent_lump_gives_the_homogeneous_answer_only_under_a_white_boundary,
which also asserts the specular arm stays >25 % off so nobody can quietly make
the two closures agree and call it a fix.

Not only a harness lesson: the FHR pebble runs on a specular r = 3 sphere with
its fuel zone at r < 1.9, in BOTH codes. See op-qho6 for the hypothesis that
falls out of it, and its caveat (LCT-008 is vacuum-bounded and cannot be
explained this way).
title: Lesson: a specularly reflective SPHERE conserves impact parameter and is not a valid cell boundary

description:
MAINTAINER DECISION 2026-08-11: htgr_sim_v1 IS the HTR-10 simulator. This settles open question 1 in docs/reactor-scoping/htr10.md — generalise the existing example rather than spinning up a sibling.

WHAT THAT MEANS: the core model is a REWRITE, not a retune. crates/outram-park-digital-twin-engine/examples/htgr_sim_v1/physics/primary_loop.rs:3 states the existing model is a prismatic-block HTGR. There is no pebble bed anywhere in it — no packed-bed pressure drop, no bed conductivity, no pebble conduction, no graphite properties. The secondary loop, app shell and widget layer are reusable close to as-is, which is a real head start.

CURRENT STATE (audit 2026-08-06, docs/reactor-scoping/htr10.md): htgr_sim_v1 tests 12/12 pass. HAVE — helium Helmholtz EOS and real transport correlations in coolprop, Wakao packed-bed Nusselt in TUAS, three-array porous-media component structure in TUAS, doubly heterogeneous Monte Carlo in outram-mc-libs pebble_beds, TRISO release in boon-lay, granular DEM with thermal contact in liggghts, six-group PRKE in teh-o-prke, a working and tested Rankine secondary, and genuine two-way primary/secondary coupling.
MISSING — the entire pebble-bed closure set. See children.

NOT VALIDATED. Nothing HTR-10-specific is in this repository. Do not describe this simulator as validated at any point before the V&V child closes.

Serves as the heat source for the nuclear oil refinery epic op-1z3o. Supersedes the framing of op-wqk.9 and its children, three of four of which are recorded in the scoping doc as stale.

notes.author: teddy0@snrsi-arch-desktop
notes.content:
CROSS-REFERENCE from the API scoping work (op-375p / gh:#41), plus two things worth acting on inside this epic.

1. THIS EPIC'S 'CURRENT STATE' SECTION IS STALE. It is dated 2026-08-06 and states the core model is prismatic-block with 'no pebble bed anywhere in it'. As of 2026-09-04, examples/htgr_sim_v1/physics/primary_loop.rs documents itself as modelling 'a helium-cooled, graphite-moderated **pebble-bed** HTGR at HTR-10 scale'. Six children are In Progress. The retarget has clearly begun; the audit should be redone so the epic description stops contradicting the code.

2. A PLACEMENT DECISION IS DUE WHILE THE CHILDREN ARE STILL OPEN. examples/htgr_sim_v1/physics is now 11,531 lines of plant model living in an example tree, reachable from nothing else — not another Rust crate, not the Python wheel, not an agent.

This is not hypothetical. The same thing happened to the benzene/toluene distillation plant, and op-190j.4 had to lift it out afterwards, at which point the maintainer's architecture ruling was recorded as: headless plant model -> the physics crate; egui components -> the digital-twin-engine LIBRARY, not an example tree.

Applying that here while op-jyyp.1/.3/.5/.6/.12 are in flight costs little. Applying it after they close means a second lift of a larger body of code. Suggested shape: the HTR-10 plant into tampines (which already hosts the pebble_bed and gas_phase closures this epic is filling in) or into dt-engine::htr10 beside the cited design data, with htgr_sim_v1 reduced to a thin GUI over it — exactly the shape outram-foam's CaseRun / distillation_sim_v1 ended up in.

The reachability payoff is the point of op-375p: the nine HTR-10 tasks scoped there (IAEA benchmark k-eff, critical loading height, rod worth, split fuel/moderator temperature coefficients, steady peak fuel temperature against the 1620 C limit, DLOFC/PLOFC, rod withdrawal without scram, air/water ingress, then HTR-PM at module scale) are all unreachable while the model lives in an example, however finished the physics is.

No claim is made here that anything is validated — op-jyyp.11 is Todo and this epic's own prohibition stands.

title: HTR-10 pebble-bed simulator — retarget htgr_sim_v1 from prismatic to HTR-10

description: From DWSIM Pipe.vb + FluidFlowCorrelations/{BeggsBrill,LockhartMartinelli,FlowPackageBaseClass}.vb (see /home/teddy0/Documents/research/dwsim, gitignored reference clone). Consolidated Colebrook-type explicit friction-factor fit (single-phase Darcy-Weisbach, laminar/turbulent/transitional), Beggs & Brill (1973) two-phase correlation (flow-regime routing + holdup + inclination correction), Lockhart-Martinelli two-phase multiplier method. Skip Petalas-Aziz -- DWSIM only wraps an unshipped native PetAz.dll, no portable source (tracked as a separate deferred bead). Enum-dispatched (PipeFlowCorrelation), uom-typed public API, own by value / no lifetimes per workspace rules.
title: Port pipe friction correlations (Darcy-Weisbach + Beggs-Brill + Lockhart-Martinelli)
